   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` a

WITH search_campaigns AS

          c.name,

          FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', cb.snapshot_date) AS MONTH,
          cb.snapshot_date,
          cb.remaining_eur,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY cb.campaign_id, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', cb.snapshot_date)

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaign_budgets` cb

     month_end AS
  (SELECT campaign_id,

          MONTH,
          snapshot_date,
          remaining_eur
   FROM monthly_snapshots
   WHERE rn = 1 ),
     pivoted AS
  (SELECT campaign_id,
          name,
          channel,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN MONTH = '2026-08' THEN remaining_eur
              END) AS aug_remaining_eur,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN MONTH = '2026-08' THEN snapshot_date
              END) AS aug_last_snapshot,

              END) AS sep_remaining_eur,

   FROM month_end

SELECT campaign_id,

       aug_last_snapshot,
       aug_remaining_eur,
       sep_last_snapshot,
       sep_remaining_eur,
       (aug_remaining_eur - sep_remaining_eur) AS budget_left_decrease_eur
FROM pivoted
